dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent ring-like structures with irregular, high-contrast dark perimeters; gradient transitions from dark exterior pixels to light interior cores with fuzzy, non-linear edge definitions, particularly on the upper posterior quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of small, solid dark-pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated in the interstices between larger annular structures along the mid-dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest annuli on the posterior-dorsal flank form a scalene triangle; a secondary chain of four smaller features extends linearly toward the anterior-dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single, highly prominent pink-toned fleshy protrusion is visible on the ventral-lateral midline; several faint linear striations or indentations are visible on the posterior flank near the flipper base.
other_distinctive_markers: The texture distribution shows a sharp transition from high-frequency contrast patterns on the posterior two-thirds to a uniform, low-frequency monochromatic grey surface on the anterior third.
